implementation.note: implemented_in_code = a dedicated capability handler or tool directory exists; referenced_in_app_code = the entity is used by application source (e.g. repo-pet sprites, CLI) but has no dedicated handler. code_refs are files that reference this entity by name/slug/handler (grep), not a guarantee of a dedicated runtime; registry handler links point at the actual capability function.

proposed.command: mise roster run knead-guardian --dept pipeline-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: dough / build recipe, proof timer, oven schedule → outputs: baked batch, bake log, reject count; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Picture the oven light at 4 a.m.: that is where Knead Guardian is happiest. As Pipeline Kitchen's Patissier, Knead Guardian runs the bake: mixing, proofing and baking on a fixed schedule so the line always has fresh builds. The card calls out Signature, Focus, Rise To: the checks Knead Guardian runs before calling anything ready.

workflow.summary: Knead Guardian runs the bake: mixing, proofing and baking on a fixed schedule so the line always has fresh builds.
workflow.proof_gate: Proof gate: a batch goes in the oven only when proofing is complete; underproofed batches are held.
